title: サンタのどうぶつ
subject_en: six different original kawaii animals, each wearing a red Santa hat or Santa outfit
lead: ねこ、いぬ、うさぎ、くま、ペンギン、ひつじが、サンタの衣装でクリスマスをお祝い。カードやお店のポップに。
items: a chubby cream cat with brown face patches in a Santa hat, holding a small gift
a round tan puppy with cream face mask in a Santa hat, carrying a gift sack
a white lop-eared rabbit in a Santa outfit with a pom-pom hat, ringing a bell
a chestnut-brown bear with a cream heart belly patch in a Santa suit holding a big gift
a blue-grey penguin with yellow cheek patches in a Santa hat, holding a candy cane
a fluffy cream sheep in a Santa hat and red scarf with a small gift
